correctness.rationale: For every invariant compact-fiber law with Lebesgue base marginal, derive the exact conditional moment recurrences from equal dyadic inverse-branch weights. Unique bounded solutions follow from |alpha|<1. The first two moments give alpha² Pm₂=v. The cubic recurrence then has g₀=g₂=3alpha²/4, Pg=g₀+g₂ cos(2pi x), P²g=g₀, yielding the third centered moment by the convergent resolvent. Positivity thresholds follow from elementary cosine inequalities and arc length. Global third moment and injectivity follow by integration and comparing ±|alpha|. Exact Fourier consistency checks included in verify.py; no finite sample is relied upon for proof.

value.rationale: The third conditional moment is the first statistic that resolves an exact signed-parameter degeneracy of the entire first-two-moment profile. It exposes a sharp parameter-dependent sign reversal for negative fiber contraction, including an exact proportion of fibers with positive skewness that rises from zero to one-third, despite always-positive global third moment. The pair of global variance and cubic moment recovers the signed contraction. These are natural dynamical inference and fiber-statistics questions rather than isolated computational constants; the phenomenon is not inferable from the previous mean/variance values alone.
